notes.title: Regarding the DLCs and Recent Chinese Language Update
notes.content:
Due to some issues users have been having with the recent Chinese language update, we've come to realize that these issues were stemming from users who install the Chinese language version of the base game while not renaming the files for the various DLCs. This will cause and issue where the engine logo will appear on screen but the game will not continue to load.

It is important when using the Chinese version of the game to use the Chinese version of the DLCs as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30565575/74eb3bd3e75c4cb1b987fa527987dfd0c92e8656.png[/img]

Likewise, if you were using the Chinese version before and decide to switch back to English, please be sure to use the English version of the DLC files.

[b]UPDATE:[/b]
We've modified the DLC so that you no longer have to rename the downloaded file.  When you change languages, Steam should automatically swap to the corresponding language DLC.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: NE NO KAMI - THE TWO PRINCESS KNIGHTS OF KYOTO PART 2 Update
notes.content:
An update was pushed just now where users with their game set to English would still end up running the Chinese version of the game. Now when selecting English under the Language tab in Properties, the game will update with the English language files only.

We apologize for any confusion this may have caused.

notes.title: Ne no Kami: The Two Princess Knights of Kyoto Part 2 now in Simplified Chinese!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30565575/25b4309a8686dab4f46d6259172cf05dd20f566b.png[/img]

Happy Monday to everyone. we're pleased to announce that part two of the Ne no Kami series is now available in Simplified Chinese! A big thanks to the 白衣汉化组 translation team for making this happen.

If you've already purchased the game, all you need to do is go in to your library, right click Ne no Kami Part 2, then click on Properties. Under the Languages tab, select Simplified Chinese from the dropdown menu and the download should begin right away. If you're on the fence about picking up the game, the entire series including DLC are now on sale with a 45% discount this week so don't miss out on this opportunity!

根神京姬 后篇中文语言设定指南 (Guide to Changing Settings to Chinese)
1) 在Library,按鼠标右键点击"根神京姬 后篇",然后打开"Properties"。
2) 点击在上面的”Languages”标签。
3) 在语言列表中，选择“简体中文”。
4) 点击“Close”后，根神京姬 后篇会自动更新。
